name.ja: プラノサウルス プテラノドン

description.ja: 自分の手で恐竜を“知りつくす”ブランド『プラノサウルス』第７弾に、空翔ける翼竜の代表格「プテラノドン」が登場！
description.en: Pteranodon, the representative flying pterosaur, is now available in the 7th installment of Planosaurus, a brand that helps you get to know dinosaurs with your own hands!

description.ja: • 「骨格ビルド」で恐竜の内部構造から知ることができる。
description.en: • "Skeleton Build" allows you to learn about the internal structure of dinosaurs.

description.ja: • 「恐竜ビルド」で骨格の上から外皮パーツを取り付けるプラモデルならではの仕様で恐竜の姿を復元。
description.en: • "Dinosaur Build" allows you to restore the dinosaur's appearance using specifications unique to plastic models, where the skin parts are attached to the top of the skeleton.

description.ja: • ニッパー等の道具や接着剤が必要ないから簡単に組み立てられる。
description.en: • Easy to assemble as there is no need for tools such as nippers or adhesives.

description.ja: • 繊細な骨格を頑丈な角質で覆った巨大な嘴は、その口内の構造も含めて最新の学説に基づき立体化。
description.en: • The giant beak, which has a delicate skeleton covered with tough keratin, has been sculpted into three-dimensional form based on the latest theory, including the structure of its mouth.

description.ja: • 翼竜を象徴する翼膜は、表面の強靭な筋状繊維の流れをリアルに表現。
description.en: • The wing membrane, which symbolizes pterosaurs, realistically expresses the flow of strong muscular fibers on the surface.

description.ja: • 昇降舵として用いられたとされる翼竜固有の「翼支骨」を、最新の復元に基づいた造形で再現。
description.en: • The unique "wing bones" of pterosaurs, which are said to have been used as elevators, are recreated using the latest reconstruction.

description.ja: • 肩甲骨と胴椎が関節となり力強い羽ばたきを生み出すための特殊な骨格の構造も忠実に再現。
description.en: • The special skeletal structure where the shoulder blades and torso vertebrae act as joints to produce powerful wing flapping has also been faithfully reproduced.

description.ja: • パーツ選択により「着地状態」を再現可能。翼を折り畳んだ時の翼膜のシワや、地上で足をカカトまで接地した状態を再現可能。
description.en: • "Landing condition" can be reproduced by selecting parts. It is possible to reproduce the wrinkles in the wing membrane when the wings are folded and the state in which the feet are in contact with the heel on the ground.

description.ja: • 台座を使用することで飛行する姿のままディスプレイが可能。
description.en: • By using the pedestal, it is possible to display it in its flying form.

accessories.en: Parts for landing condition x 1 set
